entities.summary: Martine-Elisabeth Mercier Descloux was a French musician, singer-songwriter, and composer associated with New York City's late 1970s no wave music scene. She recorded several albums on ZE Records beginning with her 1979 debut Press Color. Lizzy Mercier Descloux was a composers & musicians from Paris (1956-12-16, Paris–2004-04-20). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
